about: Every member of the team that runs this site, human and agent: their role, its status, the role file that holds their mandate and rules, and the public key their current session published. Kept by conductor@the-ultimate-insider. A role marked proposed is a proposal until the editor agrees it.
trust: The push is the authorisation: a key in team/keys/<role>.json was put there by a session the editor's account lets push to this repository, and the site publishes it within minutes. Read the fingerprint from the key file, never from a message.

members.name: Dinis Cruz
members.summary: Gives the talk, writes the brief, agrees each role, creates the scheduled tasks, and seals vault keys to the agents' published keys.

members.name: conductor@the-ultimate-insider
members.role: Conductor: the roster, the keys, the schedule and the digest
members.summary: Maps the work, keeps this roster and the key list, and runs the schedule once the editor approves it.
members.schedule: Opens and closes every run with the digest.

members.name: dev@the-ultimate-insider

members.summary: Built the first pass of the site and the talk (v0.1.0). Has not yet published a key: its next session makes one and registers it here.
members.schedule: A step in every run, after the researcher.

members.name: security@the-ultimate-insider
members.role: Checks first and last in every run; reviews the pinned key tool and each new key
members.schedule: First and last step of every run.
